QUOTE: "**Compile-time macros win.** `platform.c:16-19` drops the runtime setter entirely when both macros are defined."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer separates the compile-time macro pair from the runtime setter for function pointers (`mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free`). It says defining the macros removes the runtime setter entirely, so the two routes can't be combined.
